'''Adam Tyler''' is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the image on two cards: •Rogue One and its AI printing, both in [[Virtual Set 6]], released 14 April 2017.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> He is not the 2024 Retro League player of the same name (see [[Adam Tyler]]).

== Card credits ==
Two cards in all (Image: 2).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The table gives each card, its set and the set's release date, and the credit exactly as printed.
